B75 CI HOTFIX — MANUAL GITHUB EDIT

Do not upload a .github folder from Android.

1. Open this existing repository file in GitHub:
   .github/workflows/android-debug-apk.yml
2. Tap Edit (pencil).
3. Select all existing content and replace it with the full contents of:
   android-debug-apk.yml
4. Commit with:
   Fix Android SDK CI setup
5. Wait for the new Build Android Debug APK run.

This is a CI-only hotfix. No app version bump is required.
